title: composition.json of a composite control (扩展控件 P1, K3)
description: Three things only: the layout its children get (an algorithm the host ships: stack or fixed, K2), the slots user content lives in, and the Chrome drawn around them from config (R23). It never creates or deletes user Blocks: they stay real Blocks of the BlockTree, each carrying `slot`. `ext.build` checks it (store/src/ext.rs), the Desktop draws it (ui/controls/composite/); the core keeps only its shape (an object ≤ 64 KiB, ≤ 16 slots, no events). String values may be `{{config.<key>}}` with the key declared in config_schema.properties. `events` is P2 and fails the build.

algorithm.description: stack: the slots' children one after another (column or row); fixed: every child keeps its own x / y (none is "auto")

padding.description: inner margin, px (all sides, or { t, r, b, l })

accepts.description: what may fill it: `cell:<ident>` (an instance of that control: in deps or already in this Workspace), a view type (`richtext`, `shape`, `card`, …), or `container` (a group or a control); absent: any Block

min.description: Blocks the Desktop creates when inserting an instance (empty Cells of the first accepted view)

max.description: the clients refuse more (the core does not count, Q15)

placement.description: where the slot sits in a stack: before (top) or after (bottom) the stacked slots, in order (stack); free: children keep their x / y (the only placement of a fixed layout)

slot.description: draw the title only while this slot is empty

empty.description: what an empty instance shows, may hold {{config.<key>}}

config_ref.description: `{{config.<key>}}`: the instance's config value (its definition's default when unset); the key must be in config_schema.properties
